topic: Important Airports and Seaports of India
description: This topic covers the geographical locations and key characteristics of major international airports and seaports in India. It is a highly crucial topic under Static GK for competitive examinations.

sections.title: Important Facts regarding Aviation and Shipping
sections.description: Crucial one-liner facts related to Indian airports and seaports that are frequently asked in competitive exams.

important_facts.fact: India currently has 13 Major Ports and around 200 notified minor and intermediate ports along its coastline.
Tamil Nadu is the only state in India that has 3 Major Ports: Chennai, Tuticorin, and Ennore.
Port Blair Port, located in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands, was designated as the 13th major port of India.
The Airports Authority of India (AAI), functioning under the Ministry of Civil Aviation, is responsible for creating, upgrading, maintaining, and managing civil aviation infrastructure in India.
Veer Savarkar International Airport is an important strategic airport located in Port Blair, Andaman and Nicobar Islands.
